|sellprice = 565 }} The '''Rabbit's Foot''' is an [[:Category:Animal Products|animal product]] obtained from a [[Rabbit]] with sufficient [[Animals#Animal Care|friendship]], [[Animals#Animal Care|mood]], and [[Luck|daily luck]]. It can also occasionally be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|565}} or dropped by [[Serpent]]s in the [[Skull Cavern]] (0.8% chance). One may be purchased from [[Jas]] in her [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|100|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. [[Luck#Luck Buffs|Luck buffs]] do not influence the chances of getting a Rabbit's Foot. Despite the description, carrying a Rabbit's Foot does not increase the player's luck. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |hate=Penny }} ==Bundles== Rabbit's Foot is used in the {{Bundle|enchanter||y}}. ==Recipes== Rabbit's Foot is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Rabbit's Foot is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[File:Shirt095.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Rabbit's Foot is not used in any [[quests]]. ==Other Uses== *One Rabbit's Foot is used when solving the puzzle depicted in [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #20|Secret Note #20]]. *Having a Rabbit's Foot in inventory prevents a negative outcome in the [[Bouquet#Group 10-Heart Event|Group 10-Heart Event]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|Increased value from 450g to 565g.}} {{History|1.3.27|Required to solve secret note #20.
